en.headline: Museum Festival carnival continues today at Cultural Centre with pixel egg tart
en.dek: The free Fun@Museum Carnival runs through Sunday at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza as part of Muse Fest HK 2026, which continues across 17 museums until 30 November.
body: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department is holding Muse Fest HK 2026 from 31 October to 30 November. Its 17 museums and art spaces are offering more than 60 programmes. The opening Fun@Museum Carnival is taking place today and tomorrow at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza.

The carnival adopts the theme “A Collage of Past and Present, Hong Kong Story”, echoing the permanent exhibition “Hong Kong Story” at the Hong Kong Museum of History. Installations include a Grid Tea Stall, a Giant Pixel Egg Tart collaging station measuring one by 1.5 metres, a traditional Chinese herbal shop called Hong Kong Medicine Shop where visitors can experience gathering medicine, and a Happy Fortune Amusement Park recreating an old coin-throwing stall.

Free workshops cover mahjong colouring, herbal tea sign keychain making and pawnshop signboard painting. Visitors can also join an interactive Pixiu dance and solar observation. The department said the carnival is free and participants in multiple activities can receive themed souvenirs. Museum open days will take place on Saturdays and Sundays throughout November.

zh.headline: 博物館節嘉年華今日續在文化中心舉行 巨型像素蛋撻及格仔茶檔亮相
zh.dek: 免費「繽Fun博物館嘉年華」今明兩日在香港文化中心露天廣場舉行，屬香港博物館節2026一部分，17間博物館活動延至11月30日。
body: 康樂及文化事務署由10月31日至11月30日舉辦香港博物館節2026，轄下17間博物館及藝術空間推出超過60項節目。開幕節目「繽Fun博物館嘉年華」今明兩日在香港文化中心露天廣場舉行。
嘉年華主題為「拼貼今昔，香港故事」，呼應香港歷史博物館常設展覽「香港故事」。現場設有格仔茶檔、1米乘1.5米巨型像素蛋撻拼貼坊、讓參加者體驗執藥的傳統中藥舖「香江藥號」，以及重現舊日挞銀幣攤位的「Happy Fortune遊樂場」。
同場有免費工作坊，包括麻雀填色、涼茶牌鎖匙扣製作及大押招牌彩繪。市民亦可參與舞貐貅互動及太陽觀測。康文署表示活動免費，參加多項活動者可獲贈主題紀念品。11月的周六日多間博物館將舉行同樂日。
更正：修正中文版本的字符編碼問題。
